srt_situations: You are going for an important military task and suddenly receive a message that your mother is seriously ill. What will you do?
You are sleeping in a train compartment. Suddenly, the train stops with a massive jerk in the middle of a jungle and you hear people crying for help. What will you do?
You catch your close roommate and best friend stealing money from another candidate's bag in the hostel. What will you do?
You are driving to your final ISSB interview. A car in front of you meets a terrible accident and people are injured. You are getting late. What will you do?
You are returning home late at night. Four armed thugs surround you in a dark alley and demand your wallet, phone, and watch. You are unarmed. What will you do?
You are walking near a deep river. Suddenly, you see a child drowning. You know how to swim, but the water current is very fast. What will you do?
Your team is losing a critical sports match, and your team members start blaming and fighting with each other. As the team captain, what will you do?
Your commanding officer gives you a strict order to execute a task, but you realize the plan has a major flaw and might fail. What will you do?
You see an angry mob beating an alleged thief mercilessly on the street. There is no police nearby and they might kill him. What will you do?
You are traveling to a hill station with your family. Suddenly, your car's engine heats up and stops working in a completely deserted area with no mobile signals. What will you do?
